title: Skillet Pork Chops, Pan Sauce
note: No flour anywhere — here to prove the format handles a plain weeknight main as cleanly as it handles bread.
steps: Salt the chops and leave them uncovered on a rack for at least 40 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Pat bone dry. Heat oil in a heavy skillet until it just smokes.
Sear undisturbed 4 minutes. Flip, add butter, garlic, and thyme, and baste continuously for 3–4 minutes until the center reads 138°F.
Move to a plate to rest 8 minutes. It will climb to 145°F.
Pour off all but a film of fat. Add wine, scrape the fond, reduce to a glaze.
Add stock, reduce by half, then swirl in a cold knob of butter off the heat. Season and pour over the rested chops.
